test_title: PYST 6: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that when placed from left to right in the blanks below will complete the given

letter series.

P Q _ S _ P P Q P _ A P P Q _ S A P _ Q
solution:
Given series: P Q _ S _ P P Q P _ A P P Q _ S A P _ Q

Option 1) QPASP→ P Q __Q__ S __P__ P P Q P __A__ A P P Q __S__ S A P __P__ Q → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) PQSAP → P Q __P__ S __Q__ P P Q P __S__ A P P Q __A__ S A P __P__ Q → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) PASPP → P Q __**P**__ S __**A**__ P P Q P __**S**__ A P P Q __**P**__ S A P __**P**__ Q → (It follows the pattern of: PQPSAP - PQPSAP - PQPSAP - PQPSAP - PQ)

Option 4) QSPAP → P Q __Q__ S __S__ P P Q P __P__ A P P Q __A__ S A P __P__ Q → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
